dogecoin.text:
Musing

In a way, the dogecoin mania is good for serious crypto projects like bitcoin and ethereum because it pulls in the hot money, reducing eth/btc volatility, decreasing the likelihood of blow off tops followed by bear markets.

Anyone else fascinated by dogecoin, the coin, and dogeNFT, the fractionalized meme? Which is more true to the DOGE?  If I had to buy one, I’d go for the NFT….
